_readme: Reference-only constants shared conceptually between backend and frontend. Because backend/ and frontend/ are independent npm packages (see README 'Project structure' for why), this file is NOT imported directly by either build — it documents the values that backend/src/constants/*.ts and frontend/src/types/*.ts must be kept in sync with. If you change one, change the other and update this file too.

levelXpThresholds.note: Levels 6+ extend this with a smoothly increasing step — see backend/src/constants/petData.ts:xpForLevel()
